title: Fix: Update button disabled state to allow hover effects while preventing clicks
body:
**Previous Behavior:**
```tsx
disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
```
The disabled button completely blocked all pointer events, preventing any hover effects or visual feedback.

**Current Behavior:**
```tsx
disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50
```
The disabled button now:
- Shows the "not-allowed" cursor on hover
- Maintains the opacity visual feedback
- Still prevents clicks while allowing hover interactions

**Why the Change:**
This improves the user experience by:
1. Providing better visual feedback when hovering over disabled buttons
2. Making it clearer that the button is intentionally disabled rather than just non-interactive
3. Following common UI patterns for disabled element behavior

**Affected Components:**
- `Button`(src/components/ui/button.tsx) component via `buttonVariants`(src/components/ui/button.tsx)

The change is purely presentational and doesn't affect the functional behavior of disabled buttons.
